kurals.tr: Akara Mudhala Ezhuththellaam Aadhi / Pakavan Mudhatre Ulaku
kurals.m: As the letter A is the first of all letters, so the eternal God is first in the world

kurals.tr: Katradhanaal Aaya Payanenkol Vaalarivan / Natraal Thozhaaar Enin
kurals.m: What Profit have those derived from learning, who worship not the good feet of Him who is possessed of pure knowledge ?

kurals.tr: Malarmisai Ekinaan Maanati Serndhaar / Nilamisai Neetuvaazh Vaar
kurals.m: They who are united to the glorious feet of Him who passes swiftly over the flower of the mind, shall flourish long above all worlds

kurals.tr: Ventudhal Ventaamai Ilaanati Serndhaarkku / Yaantum Itumpai Ila
kurals.m: To those who meditate the feet of Him who is void of desire or aversion, evil shall never come

kurals.tr: Irulser Iruvinaiyum Seraa Iraivan / Porulser Pukazhpurindhaar Maattu
kurals.m: The two-fold deeds that spring from darkness shall not adhere to those who delight in the true praise of God

l: the One who stilled all five
those who keep to the path
kurals.tr: Porivaayil Aindhaviththaan Poidheer Ozhukka / Nerinindraar Neetuvaazh Vaar
kurals.m: Those shall long proposer who abide in the faultless way of Him who has destroyed the five desires of the senses

l: for those who reach His feet
kurals.tr: Thanakkuvamai Illaadhaan Thaalserndhaark Kallaal / Manakkavalai Maatral Aridhu
kurals.m: Anxiety of mind cannot be removed, except from those who are united to the feet of Him who is incomparable

l: for those who reach His feet
kurals.tr: Aravaazhi Andhanan Thaalserndhaark Kallaal / Piravaazhi Neendhal Aridhu
kurals.m: None can swim the sea of vice, but those who are united to the feet of that gracious Being who is a sea of virtue

kurals.tr: Kolil Poriyin Kunamilave Enkunaththaan / Thaalai Vanangaath Thalai
kurals.m: The head that worships not the feet of Him who is possessed of eight attributes, is as useless as a sense without the power of sensation

l: those who do not reach the feet
kurals.tr: Piravip Perungatal Neendhuvar Neendhaar / Iraivan Atiseraa Thaar
kurals.m: None can swim the great sea of births but those who are united to the feet of God
